CRABEL_ORB_2026.original_market_tf: Daily futures research, intraday opening trigger/nextdayexit

FIDELITY_RSI.author: Fidelity technical indicator guide
FIDELITY_RSI.original_market_tf: Generic technical indicator; crypto30m is adaptation
FIDELITY_RSI.rule: Bottom swing failure is a higher RSI low followed by a break above its prior high; top is the lower-high converse.
FIDELITY_RSI.version: Public page retrieved2026-09-17; no dated method version

GUPPY_GMMA.author: Daryl Guppy
GUPPY_GMMA.original_market_tf: Intraday andinvestment contexts explicitlysupported; exact30mmechanics unspecified
GUPPY_GMMA.rule: Two moving-average groups represent short/long participants. Within-group andbetween-group separation/compression diagnose trend character; longgroup setsdirection. Crossoversalone arenotthetool.

PARKER_COMPANY.rule: Systematic price-based trendfollowing anddiversification areconfirmed; exact parameters/holdhorizons arenotprovided.
